name: c8y/pi-historian-flow
description: tedge-flow that polls AVEVA PI Web API and publishes measurements to Cumulocity

scripts.package: npm run build && COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar czf ../pi-historian-flow.tar.gz package.json flows.toml params.toml params.toml.template dist/main.js scripts/poll-pi.sh
scripts.undeploy:local: sudo rm -rf /etc/tedge/mappers/c8y/flows/pi-historian-flow && sudo systemctl restart tedge-mapper-c8y
